0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Bulls on the road. Chicago is without Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins (both out with illness) and Nic Claxton (out with a hamstring injury), while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out after Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out with a foot injury). Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win over Chicago in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
